changes: Added a read-only advisory reviewer command policy: cli-engine now enforces KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 before hooks/owner leases; role-separation docs and session ownership docs describe the contract; command ownership and smoke tests cover blocked reviewer writes; koala-evaluator template plus .claude/.Codex generated prompts now warn normal gate reviewers not to set readonly mode.
usage: Owners launching separate advisory Claude/Codex/Gemini reviewers can set KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 on that spawned process only. Normal Koala reviewer lanes keep writing review_run/finding/pass evidence. After template edits, use node bin/koala.js check --apply and node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex.
expectedOutcome: Advisory read-only reviewers can inspect but cannot mutate Koala review/finding/lifecycle artifacts; official gate reviewers still write signed evidence; generated Claude/Codex prompts stay synchronized from the template.
actualTranscript: Builds passed; command ownership and reviewer-readonly smoke tests passed; process/runtime fact contracts passed; node bin/koala.js check is OK; node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex is 6/7 pass with only the known global fallback worktree warning; validate reports 15/15 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No functional difference from expected; one non-blocking global fallback warning remains because global koala resolves to main checkout, so local node bin/koala.js is the authority for this worktree.
limitations: Advisory mode only applies when the owner explicitly sets KOALA_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 on a spawned advisory process. It prevents Koala artifact mutation, not arbitrary external CLI behavior outside Koala.
pitfalls: Two important pitfalls were captured: editing generated .claude/.Codex prompt files directly causes managed asset drift, so the source template must be changed and synced; using global koala check in this worktree can read main-checkout templates, so local node bin/koala.js is required for authoritative checks.
